{{Quote|The Mystics have a vision. An outsider will end the threat of the Gormak. We believe it is you.|Laryn-Ki to a traveling Republic hero|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Laryn-Ki''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] emissary on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He eventually helped in securing an alliance between the Voss and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
